title: Theory-to-Data Identifiability Audit v001
question: Can the currently available public human datasets support a fair quantitative model comparison between MEM and hierarchical Bayesian interoceptive inference without adding theory-extraneous observation mappings or arbitrary latent-state choices?

strict_rule.core_variable_coverage: Every theory-specific variable required to generate the target outcome must be observed, computable from observed variables with a source-specified function, or identifiable as a latent parameter under a source-specified generative/observation model.
strict_rule.outcome_mapping: The theory must specify how its latent states generate the measured outcome used for comparison.
strict_rule.parameter_identifiability: There must be a defined fitting procedure plus parameter/model recovery or an equivalent identifiability demonstration for the target task.
strict_rule.no_custom_rescue: Do not invent an observation link, hidden-state definition, prototype set, fusion function, or report mapping solely to make a theory fit the dataset.

H001_Parrotta_pain_false_feedback.notes: False cardiac feedback manipulation, pain stimulus intensity, ECG-derived cardiac summaries, and first-person pain ratings.

HDT_interoceptive_training.notes: Task and code were designed together for a hierarchical Bayesian heartbeat-discrimination model.

required_core.name: A(t)
required_core.reason: requires n(t), tolerated bounds, w_A, c_A

required_core.name: h_eff_sens
required_core.reason: psi can be implementation-dependent; simple weighted-average is an example

required_core.name: phenomenal_report_link
required_core.meaning: mapping from MEM state to LIK/VAS or sync judgment

Hierarchical_Bayesian_HDT_2026.source: Suksasilp et al. 2026 Biological Psychology + public GitHub implementation
Hierarchical_Bayesian_HDT_2026.warning: This model's specified observation model is for heartbeat discrimination choices, not H001 LIK/VAS pain ratings.

MEM_2026_primary_formalism.reason: Core reconstruction/context/allostatic variables and the report observation link are absent or implementation-dependent.

Hierarchical_Bayesian_HDT_2026.reason: The published generative/observation model is task-specific to sync/async heartbeat discrimination and has no source-specified LIK/VAS observation model.

MEM_2026_primary_formalism.reason: MEM does not specify a heartbeat-discrimination response likelihood, semblion training history/prototypes, or parameter-recovery procedure for this task.

Hierarchical_Bayesian_HDT_2026.reason: Public task-specific generative model, fitting code, identifiability simulation and parameter recovery exist.

cross_theory_gate: PASS only if both models PASS on the same dataset and same held-out target outcome under source-specified mappings.
